# Handpan Theory

> Free chord flashcards and printable poker-size chord cards for handpans, with a page for each scale.

- [Handpan Theory app](https://handpan.raywu.org/): the flashcard app
- [Handpan 101](https://handpan.raywu.org/handpan-101/): a beginner guide
- [Scales](https://handpan.raywu.org/scales/): every scale
